job.job_description:
At Starlabs Technologies, were on a mission to create products driven by groundbreaking innovations
We are looking for a talented and enthusiastic Backend Developer Intern to join our growing team
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to gain hands-on experience working with cutting-edge technologies in a dynamic environment
Collaborate with the backend team to develop and maintain APIs using Python and FastAPI
Assist in the design and implementation of efficient, scalable server-side applications
Familiarity with Python programming language
Experience with FastAPI (or willingness to learn)
Knowledge of RESTful API design and development
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment
A passion for backend development and eagerness to learn new technologies
Write clean, well-documented, and efficient code
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize code to ensure high performance and reliability
Participate in code reviews and learn best practices in software development
Contribute to the integration of various third-party services and APIs Strong communication skills
job.ai_reason: Strong production FastAPI backend and RAG experience with AWS deployments.

ai_evaluation.reason: Strong production FastAPI backend and RAG experience with AWS deployments.
